verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a commercial SaaS security and compliance platform, and publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a public source repository or an open-source license. The downloadable OpenAPI specs describe the API surface; they are not readable product source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
